title: 🔥 NEW MSFS 2024 Airports This Week – EFHK Helsinki, KBUR Burbank & More! Marketplace Update (PC)
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: EFHK Helsinki, KBUR Burbank & New Scenery!

The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 11, 2026, is officially here! This week features a massive lineup of new PC releases, including high-fidelity versions of EFHK Helsinki Vantaa by MK-STUDIOS and KBUR Hollywood Burbank by Beautiful Model of the World. Whether you are flying airliners or regional ops, these new MSFS airports are must-haves for your collection.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)

The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Creative Mesh: 2U8 Thomas Creek Airport (Great GA destination in Idaho)
🛫 MK-STUDIOS: EFHK Helsinki Vantaa (Major international hub in Finland)
🛫 FSDG: FMEP Reunion Saint-Pierre Pierrefonds (Scenic island airport)
🛫 SPINOZA: KBDR Sikorsky Memorial Airport (Regional airport in Connecticut)
🛫 Beautiful Model of the World: KBUR Hollywood Burbank (Popular LA-area airport)
🛫 SimPixel: LIRA Rome Ciampino (Secondary airport serving Rome)
🛫 wingsim: SKEJ Airport Yariguies (Colombian regional destination)
🛫 wingsim: SKPC Airport German Olano (South American GA airport)
🛫 Azrsim: UBBF Fuzuli Karabakh International Airport (Modern airport in Azerbaijan)
